org_research:
BWOPA-PAC — Statewide Candidate Endorsement Application. Transcribed verbatim.

NO DUE DATE STATED.

MISSION. "To advance, educate, and support Black Women in politics, leadership and public service." Several questions ask directly how the candidacy aligns with that mission and what the candidate has done that directly impacted Black women, families and communities of colour.

MOST ANSWERS ARE CAPPED AT 300 WORDS.

FORM QUIRK. The Economic Security question appears twice under Policy Areas on the application, with identical wording; it is kept once here.

NOTE ON THE MONEY FIELDS. The form asks for campaign budget and contribution limits. Berkeley's Election Reform Act caps every contribution at $60 per donor and bars corporate, business, union and PAC money, so those fields are answered by ordinance rather than by choice.

Research not attached.
